article.title: Power grows out of the organisation of people: The Forty-Seventh Newsletter (2026)
article.author: Vijay Prashad
article.content: Moments of mobilisation can shake the system without transforming it; what endures is the patient work of organisation, through which working people build institutions, exercise collective authority, and gain the capacity to shape their lives. The post Power grows out of the organisation of people: The Forty-Seventh Newsletter (2026) appeared first on MR Online .
